`root>plain` becomes the containing block, so `root>plain>pin` is positioned from `plain`’s padding box. `plain`’s border box starts at `(20,20)`, and its `padding-left/top` is `30`, so the padding box starts at `(50,50)`. Adding `left: 10px; top: 10px` puts `pin` at `(60,60)`.

ANSWER: 60,60
